name: Alchemical Crafting
npc: Cannith Melting Station (House Cannith Manufactury) makes the manufactured ingredients; Cannith Reforging Station (Artificer Workshops, Toven's Workshop) adds the material type and crafts every Legendary tier; Cannith Binding Station (Research Facility, Eldritch Site Prime) adds heroic Tiers 1-3; a second Melting and Reforging Station stand in Sharn - Cliffside Docks District, and the Melting Station is also a Guild Ship amenity

name: Dinosaur Bone crafting
npc: Sharpened Bone, whose barter window creates Isle of Dread augments and Dinosaur Bone weapons; augments are slotted through the Augment Item UI in the inventory panel

name: Green Steel items
npc: Altar of Fecundity in Meridia for blanks; Altars of Invasion, Subjugation and Devastation in The Shroud (phases 1, 3 and 5) for upgrades; a Green Steel Crafting Hall on Guild Airships holds all the altars
